title: Schedule-foundation publication ledger
description: Append-only, root-scoped observation ledger written at the fixed relative path schedule-foundation-publications.json. It is outside selectable Save slots, profiles, autosaves and RunSnapshot/SaveDocument restore participants: selected Load, New Run, profile reset, ordinary rollback and recovery-journal rewind never delete, replace or lower a record. Each records key is exactly kind + ':' + semantic_receipt.receipt_id, and publication_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 over the canonical UTF-8 JSON of publication with no trailing newline. ScheduleFoundationPublicationLedger._SCHEMA mirrors this contract and adds the key, hash and receipt-binding laws the dialect cannot express.
